title: RISK: Class A (10.x) support in Central US for the agent subnet is contradicted between sources
description: Learn 'Supported regions' table (ms.date 2026-08-20) lists Central US Class A = Yes and states Class A is supported in every region where Agent Service is available. But the official 15b BYO-VNet sample README lists a FIXED subset that OMITS Central US: Australia East, Brazil South, Canada East, East US, East US 2, France Central, Germany West Central, Italy North, Japan East, South Africa North, South Central US, South India, Spain Central, Sweden Central, UAE North, UK South, West US, West US 3. Learn troubleshooting also documents the real error: 'Provided subnet must be of the proper address space. Please provide a subnet which has address space in the range of 172 or 192.' Failure mode is expensive - it surfaces at capability host creation, after Foundry is deployed. MITIGATION: add 172.16.0.0/16 as a second address space on vnet-fwf-cus and move snet-agent to 172.16.0.0/24 while the subnet is still empty. Cheap now, painful later.

title: Stop-Lab.ps1 and teardown guidance
description: Delete AND purge Foundry accounts before the VNet - the serviceAssociationLink on the agent subnet blocks VNet deletion otherwise.
notes: Teardown executed and Stop-Lab.ps1 corrected against the real run. Two defects found: (1) it targeted account_capability_host, which is not managed in Terraform because the platform renames it to <account>@aml_aiagentservice; (2) it purged accounts AFTER the full destroy, but the purge must precede VNet deletion or the serviceAssociationLink blocks it. Also added a wait loop - a network-injected account sits in Deleting for 15-20 min - and fixed the resource group parse for list-deleted payloads.

title: Wire the agent to the knowledge base and query it from the jumpbox
notes: RESOLVED. Root cause was the MODEL, not networking. An agent on gpt-5.2 with the azure_ai_search tool fails every run with an opaque server_error and no run steps; the identical agent on gpt-4o completes and answers with a citation. Proven by holding tool, index, connection and query_type constant and swapping only the model (scripts/jumpbox/Debug-SearchToolModels.ps1). Also disproved along the way: network path (agent still failed with Search publicNetworkAccess temporarily Enabled, then reverted), RBAC, connection shape, query_type, and index schema. Fix: gpt-4o deployed as agent_tool_model in Terraform and surfaced via outputs; Invoke-FoundryAgent.ps1 recreates any agent pinned to the wrong model. gpt-5.2 remains the knowledge base planner where it works fine.
